meta.note: The catalogue of object kinds and what an agent can do with each: one entry per kind, whether the Revit model has a family for it (modelled) or the owner adds it per room in program/objects.json (not modelled). Kinds are the ones scripts/rasterise.py gives the furniture from its family name, plus the unmodelled ones. An entry filled from general use rather than the owner's words says inferred: true and is to be confirmed. Started 2026-11-06 with the Level 3 crit rooms.

fields.actions: what an agent does there: verb, posture (standing, seated), people at once, typical minutes as [low, high]
fields.movable: whether people move it in use (owner's rules per room in objects.json override this)
fields.needs: what the action depends on: another object kind, a wall, a chair

pinup_wall.label: Pin-up wall
pinup_wall.description: A felt or fabric pin-up surface fixed directly to the wall, on every opaque wall of a crit room. Not in the Revit model; added per room.

actions.note: one group pins down as the next pins up
duration comes with the crit activity (handover notes, to import)

actions.posture: seated or standing, facing the wall

screen.label: Projection screen
screen.description: A screen that descends from a housing mounted high on the wall. In both Level 3 crit rooms it is on the short wall on the door's side (the west wall). Not in the Revit model; added per room.

projector.label: Projector
projector.description: Projects onto the screen. The owner confirms one in each Level 3 crit room; its mounting and position are not given and are placed as ceiling-mounted, facing the screen.

actions.posture: standing by the screen or seated
actions.note: studio lectures and internal slide presentations

pinup.label: Pin-up board (freestanding)
pinup.description: SALA_Pinup_Board, the freestanding boards in the studio and the corridor. On casters; the board at the end of each desk bay is more a divider than a pin-up. Not typically moved during the semester; movable when the movable_furniture toggle is on.

desk.label: Desk
desk.description: SALA_Desk, one student's desk in the studio (on casters, not typically moved during the semester, movable with the movable_furniture toggle; assigned by cohort zone, see objects.json zones); and, added by rule (objects.json by_use), the occupant's desk in every individual office, sized by the room.

chair.label: Chair
chair.description: Zeph multipurpose chairs and other seating; the seat an agent takes at a desk or table, or turns to face a pin-up wall.
chair.source: owner, chat 2026-11-06 (crit rooms: chairs are turned and shifted as presentations move wall to wall)

table.label: Table
table.description: Classroom and SALA tables. Seats a group around it for seminars and classes; in the crit rooms on casters, moved to the side or stacked top to top for presentations. In the photography room the table holds the model being photographed (added there).

actions.note: the photography room: a model on the table, the backdrop down, the lights on; session length assumed

table.source: owner, chat 2026-11-06 (crit rooms); seminar seating from the owner, capacities general

computers.label: Computer station
computers.description: SALA computer stations and monitors. In the studio the desktop computers in the middle of the floor are primarily used for sending prints to the big plotters, by all students.

actions.note: the studio's computers: a print job to the plotters

seating.label: Sofa or bench
seating.description: Sofas and benches, mostly in the lounge.

counter.label: Counter
counter.description: Kitchen counters, casework, sinks, the keg fridge and the bar edge.

printer.label: Printer or plotter
printer.description: The two Designjet plotters at the north end of the studio (modelled) and three large printers for 8.5 by 11 and 11 by 17 beside them (added, O24 to O26). Used by all students; printing is concentrated in this one area for the whole floor. Jobs go to the plotters from the desktop computers in the middle of the floor.
printer.source: owner, chat 2026-11-06 (what and who); durations general

cutting.label: Cutting table
cutting.description: Cutting tables for model making: the studio's and the assembly room's (75, added).

elevator.label: Elevator
elevator.description: The southern elevator: the car in the south stair core, on every level. People may use it to move between floors (owner, 2026-11-06).
elevator.source: owner, chat 2026-11-06 (its presence and that people use it); capacity general

sink.label: Sink
sink.description: The double-bowl sink in the middle of the kitchen's west counter (modelled); and the washroom sinks, approximately three per washroom on a counter (added by rule).

fridge.label: Fridge
fridge.description: A fridge in the north-east corner of the kitchen and another in the north-east corner of the lounge. Not in the Revit model; added per room.

actions.note: put food in, take it out

microwave.label: Microwave
microwave.description: One on each kitchen counter. Communal: not everyone uses them, many prefer a personal appliance.
microwave.source: owner, chat 2026-11-06; the share of users is pending

kettle.label: Kettle
kettle.description: Kettles on the kitchen counters, communal.
kettle.source: owner, chat 2026-11-06; count and place on the counter assumed

coffee_machine.label: Coffee machine
coffee_machine.description: A coffee machine and other tabletop appliances on the kitchen counters, communal.
coffee_machine.source: owner, chat 2026-11-06; place on the counter assumed

bar.label: Bar counter
bar.description: The lounge bar against the service shaft (the model's 'Ray's Bar' piece; the owner says the real counter is longer). Two beers on tap.

actions.note: who serves and when is pending

actions.posture: standing at, or on a stool

beer_tap.label: Beer tap
beer_tap.description: Two beers on tap at the bar: the two squares with a small faucet behind the bar, beside the keg fridge.

serving_table.label: Serving table
serving_table.description: A kitchen- or bar-height serving table, 4.9 m long, along the kitchen wall of the lounge (the model's 'Family5').

actions.note: likely where Waffle Times food is set out; to confirm with the handover schedule

serving_table.source: owner, chat 2026-11-06 (what it is); its use at events inferred

pew_bench.label: Pew bench
pew_bench.description: Church-pew-like benches with a high back, standing along the studio desks on the lounge's south edge with the back against the desks, facing into the lounge: the model's four 'Family7' pieces, confirmed by the owner.
pew_bench.source: owner, chat 2026-11-06 (plan screenshot); extent inferred from the desk row

coffee_table.label: Coffee table
coffee_table.description: The low table in front of the couch (the model's 'Bench2').

shelf.label: Shelf
shelf.description: The shelf in the 3D-printing room on the wall opposite the window, carrying the printers. Not in the Revit model; added.
shelf.source: owner, chat 2026-11-06 (the shelf and its wall); its size assumed

printer3d.label: 3D printer
printer3d.description: Small 3D printers on the shelf in room 6, at least six. Any architecture student may use them and brings their own filament. A print runs for hours unattended; prints fail for unforeseen reasons, and when the printers are busy a student moves another's finished or failed work aside.

actions.note: then the student leaves; the printer is busy for hours
when the print ends; may find it failed
another student's work, when the printers are very busy

printer3d.source: owner, chat 2026-11-06; print durations, the failure share and how busy they are are pending

backdrop.label: Photo backdrop
backdrop.description: A backdrop that drops down from the wall in the photography room, behind the table. Not in the Revit model; added.
backdrop.source: owner, chat 2026-11-06 (the backdrop); its wall assumed

light_stand.label: Photo light
light_stand.description: Some lights in the photography room, taken as two on stands either side of the table.
light_stand.source: owner, chat 2026-11-06 (some lights); count and places assumed

lamp.label: Pendant lamp
lamp.description: Pendant lamps; not interactive and not drawn.

stall.label: Washroom stall
stall.description: A toilet stall in a washroom, placed by rule: approximately four per washroom (owner, 2026-11-06).

urinal.label: Urinal
urinal.description: A urinal in a men's washroom, in place of a stall where the owner says so (room 38).

machine.label: Workshop machine
machine.description: A machine in the workshop (room 74): wood tools and one metal bending tool, the owner says; each piece names its tool. Used under supervision in business hours.
